summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a provider picker in the DSH web UI and supports browser login or local session import to switch between Codex, Grok, Claude, Cursor, and Antigravity accounts/models.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to integrate DeepSeek Harness with multiple external AI providers by adding a supplier picker and account actions inside the DSH web interface, with login and import options for supported services. Evidence from the repository metadata and README consistently frames it as an external-service connector for model/provider switching (rather than testing, media, file, or general system utilities) and it is explicitly a Windows-focused fork, so classification is kept conservative to external-service integration.
